decisions.reason: B is the remaining archiving and reporting product after A was withdrawn and fits the announced data-driven, web-based direction, so management would rather fold it into its software platform than drop it, though its low visibility and lack of observation since 2019 leave real risk of consolidation.
The manhole door with safety railing has its own web page and extends the established hardware line for municipal operators, where safety equipment sells steadily and costs little to keep.

The floating sludge extractor belongs to the core water-treatment machinery business, and weak uptake can still be attributed to long municipal procurement cycles and pandemic delays, which supports keeping it.
Control technology for water engineering machinery ties the firm's machinery to its automation and integrated-solutions strategy, so it is central to the announced direction and would be kept.

The flow measurement automation software was launched with its own web page and fits the connected, data-driven direction, so the firm's visible commitment and investment favour persisting despite the missing website records.
